page.overview:
What is Galadriel's gifts?

During the Quest of Mount Doom, Galadriel gave eight gifts to the remaining members of the Fellowship of the Ring (after the loss of Gandalf) soon before they departed from Lothlórien.

On February 16 in the year 3019 of the Third Age, Galadriel gave each member of the Fellowship of the Ring a gift to help them on their way. She gave Aragorn a magical Elven scabbard and the Elessar, a green gem set in a silver eagle shaped brooch, left for him by Arwen.

To Boromir, she gave a solid belt of gold that was crafted in Lothlórien in the shape of linked golden leaves. To Legolas, she gave a bow of the Galadhrim with a quiver of arrows, crafted deep in Lothlórien and strung with elf-hair.

Both Merry and Pippin received a silver belt with a gold, flower-shaped clasp. Samwise was given earth from Galadriel's garden, and a Mallorn seed - These were contained in a small box of grey wood with a silver G-rune on the lid. When Galadriel asked Gimli what he wanted of her, he modestly refused, but when pressed, he could think of nothing else he wanted but a single strand of her hair. She gave him three, as well as a blessing that his hands would ever flow with gold, though it would have no dominion over his mind. Galadriel then gave Frodo Baggins a small crystal vial in which was caught the light of Eärendil's star in the water of Galadriel's fountain. The phial emitted a brilliant light in darkness, so intense that dark creatures fear it. After Gandalf saved Samwise Gamgee's and Frodo’s gifts, Samwise Gamgee used it to replant trees in the Shire after the Scouring of the Shire. In Peter Jackson's , the gifts differ somewhat:
